四级核心词汇 · 11英文原文

The Parcel Without a Signature

没有签收记录的包裹 · 597 词 · 9 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A parcel of silver jewelry disappeared from a charity auction. A cop found a blank signature line. A guard alleged that a temporary assistant had carried the box through the rear door. The organizer called him a thief and wanted the police to arrest him. Detective Sol asked the guard to describe what he had witnessed. A missing box could not prove that anybody was guilty.

2The guard saw a man in a dark coat cross the alley. He recognized the assistant's walk, but the hood had disguised the man's face. The alleged theft had occurred just after the staff put away the auction's cash. Sol found a banknote and a receipt for a second parcel in a drawer. Its number was almost identical. A clerk had pasted the corresponding label on the wrong box.

3The director dismissed the label error as a trifle. Sol asked him to consider the appearance of each box. The missing one was large. The box seen in the alley fit under one arm. One might have held a jewel and the other a bottle of liquor for the banquet. The clerk could sort bottles by smell but could not identify the contents of a sealed parcel.

4A conscientious driver offered his cooperation. He had refused to sign for a damaged box because its seal had been pierced. His superior had told him to put it aside. The director suspected that he had invented the instruction to conceal the theft. Sol checked the time on the driver's message. The warehouse entry confirmed his account. It gave her a clue about where the jewels might be.

5The assistant's attorney asked the organizer to withdraw the accusation. The organizer insisted that an innocent person would answer his questions. Sol explained that the assistant had asked for legal counsel after a public insult. That was a privilege he could exercise. An arbitrary penalty could deprive him of work before the inquiry ended. The board agreed to suspend its judgment until Sol could verify both accounts.

6A donor wanted to compel the assistant to swear he had done nothing. Sol asked what would convince a jury in court that he had committed a crime. The guard's account and the label pointed in contrary directions. Justice required checking both. The director saw how a witness could mislead him without trying to deceive anybody.

7A warehouse clerk opened a second lock in front of two witnesses. The missing parcel was intact apart from a torn label. The guard admitted that he had confused two coats. The director confessed that he had accused the assistant in haste. The assistant had denied it. No one had forged a record. An arrest would have put the wrong person in jail. Sol asked the director to take responsibility for the rumor he had spread.

8The board asked whether it was liable for harm to the assistant's reputation and dignity. A member wanted him to resign quietly. The chair refused. The evidence contradicted the notice. A private correction would violate the charity's own rules. The guard helped draft it. He took out a vague reference to a suspect and gave an explicit account of the mistake.

9Before the next auction, the staff adopted a clear procedure for damaged deliveries. They recorded both parcel numbers and kept each damaged box on a visible shelf. The assistant accepted an apology and asked the director to delete his name from the old notice. Sol returned the blank form. The missing signature proved only that no one had signed. The board put that distinction in its instructions.

四级核心词汇 · 11中文译文

没有签收记录的包裹

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一次慈善拍卖会上，一包银首饰不见了。警察发现签收栏是空的。一名保安称，自己看见一位临时助手从后门拿走了箱子。组织者认定助手是贼，要警察逮捕他。侦探索尔请保安先说出亲眼看见了什么。少了一个箱子，还证明不了谁有罪。

2保安看见一个穿深色外套的男人穿过巷子。他认出了助手走路的样子，却没看清被帽兜遮住的脸。涉嫌失窃的时间，就在工作人员收好拍卖现金后。索尔在抽屉里找到一张纸币和另一个包裹的小票。两个编号几乎一样。职员把相应的标签贴错了箱子。

3负责人把贴错标签当成小事。索尔请他想想两个箱子各是什么样。失踪的包裹很大，巷子里那人拿的却能单手夹住。一个可能装首饰，另一个可能装宴会上用的一瓶烈酒。职员能凭气味给酒瓶分类，却看不出封好的包裹里是什么。

4一位做事认真的司机愿意配合。他说有个包裹的封口被扎破，所以拒绝签收。上司叫他先把东西放到一边。负责人怀疑，他编了这条指示来掩盖失窃。索尔查看司机发消息的时间，发现仓库记录能证实他的说法。这样一来，首饰可能在哪里就有了线索。

5助手的律师请组织者收回指控。组织者坚持认为，无辜的人会回答他的问题。索尔解释，助手当众受了侮辱，提出要先获得法律帮助，他有权这么做。调查结束前就随意处罚，可能让他失去工作。理事会同意暂缓判断，先等索尔核实两边的说法。

6一位捐款人想逼助手发誓，保证自己什么都没做。索尔问，如果真上法庭，有什么证据能让陪审团相信他犯了罪？保安的话和标签指向不同的结果，要公平就必须两边都查。负责人这才看出，一个人即使没有存心骗人，记错了也能把别人引向错误判断。

7仓库职员当着两位见证人的面打开了第二道锁。失踪的包裹除了标签破了一点，其余都完好。保安承认，自己弄混了两件外套。负责人也承认，他没弄清楚就指控助手，助手已经否认过了。没人伪造记录。真抓了人，就会把无辜的人送进拘留所。索尔请负责人为自己传出的传言负责。

8理事会讨论，是否要为助手的名誉和尊严受到的伤害承担责任。有人想让助手悄悄辞职，主席拒绝了。证据和公告相矛盾，私下更正会违反慈善机构自己的规则。保安也帮忙起草公开说明。他删掉含糊的“嫌疑人”指代，把自己弄错的经过写清楚。

9下次拍卖前，工作人员采纳了一套清楚的破损件处理流程。他们记录两个包裹的编号，也把破损件放到一眼能找到的架子上。助手接受道歉，并请负责人从旧公告里删掉自己的名字。索尔把空白表格还给他们。签收栏空着，只能证明当时没人签字。理事会把这一点写进了说明。
